description: Price up to 50 cards in EUR, USD or GBP, from Cardmarket (EUR) and TCGplayer (USD) side by side, with one total per market — never blended, since one is a trend and the other a market price. Name each card by `id`, or by `set` and `localId`, with an optional `variant` and `quantity`. Each line's `status` is `priced`; `unpriced`; `ambiguous`, when no `variant` was named and the copy held is unclear — name one of its `variants`; or `unavailable`, when the card could not be read or the line is malformed, which never fails the call. A missing price gives a `reason`: `no_listing`, `variant_unpriced`, `variant_not_printed`, `separate_product` (sold as a product of its own and unpriced here, like Base Set's 1st Edition or a Poké Ball reverse), `window_unavailable`, `platform_unpriced`, `unavailable` or `unrecognised_shape`. `approximateVariant` marks a price that may cover more than the printing named, and `separatelyListedPrintings` counts printings sold separately. Each price has its native `amount` and a `convertedAmount` at the ECB rate in `exchangeRates.rates`. A total is `complete` only when every line is priced. `warnings` flag markets more than 10× apart for a printing, and stale rates. Prices are for one copy in unspecified condition, before fees, and the same in every language.

basis.description: Which figure to read. 'market' is TCGplayer's market price and Cardmarket's trend; 'low' the lowest listing; the day averages are Cardmarket's alone. TCGplayer gives `window_unavailable` for an average.

cards.description: One line per card, named the way get_card names one. A bad line is reported as unavailable; it never fails the call.

id.description: Global card id, e.g. 'swsh3-136'. Give it alone; take it from a search_cards or get_set result rather than composing one.

localId.description: The number printed on the card, e.g. '105'; leading zeros are optional. Give it with `set`, not with `id`.

quantity.description: Copies held; multiplies the totals, never the prices shown.

set.description: The card's set, given with `localId`: id ('sv04.5') or printed name ('Paldean Fates'), ignoring case; a name several sets share covers them all. list_sets lists both.

variant.description: The printing, matched ignoring case: one of the examples, where 'firstEdition' means the card's 1st Edition. Name the edition of a vintage card. Omit it to list every printing, which is ambiguous unless there is only one.

currency.description: The currency to convert to. Each price is also given in its market's own currency.

language.description: Catalogue language. Names, values and set lists are localised (the Asian catalogues have their own set ids), so look values up in it; prices are the same in every language.

name: get_card_pricing

basis.description: The figure read, whether requested or defaulted to.

rateDate.description: The 'YYYY-MM-DD' publication date of the rates used. The ECB publishes on working days only, so at a weekend this is the previous Friday's.

rates.description: How many units of the requested currency one unit of a market's currency buys, unrounded, for every pair a price here was converted through. A market already in the requested currency needs no rate and has none here.

stale.description: True when they could not be refreshed and the last ones fetched were used; rateDate says how old they are.

exchangeRates.description: The exchange rates every converted amount here used. Null when nothing needed converting, or when no rates could be fetched.

language.description: The catalogue language this response was read in.

lines.description: One entry per requested line, in the order asked.

card.description: The card the line resolved to. Absent when it is unavailable.

name.description: The card's printed name in the requested language.

platform.description: Whether the card was physically printed or exists only in the digital Pokémon TCG Pocket, which no marketplace sells.

set.description: The set the card belongs to.

name.description: The set's printed name in the requested language.

message.description: Why an unavailable line could not be read. It advises retrying only when the catalogue failed transiently; a card or set that does not exist is reported without that advice, because retrying will not find it.

noPriceReasons.description: Present when there is no printing to hang a reason on: no variant was named and neither market lists any printing, or the variant named was 'wPromo', which no market here prices.

cardmarket.description: Why Cardmarket has nothing for this card.

tcgplayer.description: Why TCGplayer has nothing for this card.

request.description: The line as it was asked for, so a line whose card could not be read can still be matched to its request.

id.description: Global card id, e.g. 'swsh3-136'. Give it alone; take it from a search_cards or get_set result rather than composing one.

localId.description: The number printed on the card, e.g. '105'; leading zeros are optional. Give it with `set`, not with `id`.

set.description: The card's set, given with `localId`: id ('sv04.5') or printed name ('Paldean Fates'), ignoring case; a name several sets share covers them all. list_sets lists both.

separatelyListedPrintings.description: How many entries in upstream's per-printing list for this card are sold under a marketplace product other than the card's main one — sv08.5-004's Poké Ball and Master Ball reverses, or base1-4's 1st Edition and Shadowless printings, which share one product but count as two. A printing with no marketplace product at all is not counted. Their prices are not included here, and the ordinary printing's price is no substitute for theirs, which is why a line naming no variant of such a card is ambiguous. Absent when there are none.

status.description: 'priced': at least one market priced the line's printing, and it counts towards the totals. 'ambiguous': no variant was named and the price could not be pinned to the copy held — the card has more than one priced printing, has printings sold as products of their own (see separatelyListedPrintings), or has its one printing priced by a market that cannot say the price is that printing's — so it was left out of the totals; name one of the printings listed with a variant to price it. 'unpriced': the card was read but neither market prices it in this basis. 'unavailable': the line could not be priced as asked — its card could not be read from the catalogue, or the line itself names no card or an unknown printing; its message says which. Not the same as unpriced, and counted separately.

unrecognised.description: Parts of the upstream price data this server could not read. A card carrying any is never priced without a named variant, since it may hold a printing the variants list cannot name.

variant.description: The printing counted towards the totals: the one named, or the only one the card has. Absent when nothing was counted.

variants.description: Unit prices for one copy in each market, per printing: the printing named, or every printing either market lists when none was — followed, then, by one entry for each printing sold as a product of its own, which has no variant name, a printing description instead and both prices null with reason 'separate_product'. Empty when the card has no printing at all, or could not be read.

ageHours.description: How many hours old asOf is when this response was built, to one decimal place. Null when asOf is.

amount.description: The price in the market's own currency, for one copy in unspecified condition. A marketplace figure, not what a seller would receive after fees.

approximateVariant.description: True when the price may not be for exactly the printing named. Either the market's product covers more than it — chiefly Cardmarket, whose one product for a Jungle-to-Neo card covers 1st Edition and Unlimited alike, and whose plain column is attributed to a printing by inference when the sources disagree — or the name covers more than the product, as 'holo' does on a Base Set card, whose price is the Unlimited printing's.

anyOf.description: Upstream gave no timestamp at all.

asOf.description: When upstream last recorded this market's prices, as an ISO timestamp taken from the price data itself — never the time of this request, which can be up to an hour later than the data it served. Null if upstream gave no timestamp at all.

asOfApproximate.description: True when this market sent no timestamp of its own and asOf is the other market's, from the same upstream import.

convertedAmount.description: The price in the requested currency, rounded half-to-even to two decimals, at the rate the response's exchangeRates gives for this market's currency — the same as amount when the two currencies match. Converted at the latest reference rate, not the rate of the day the market recorded the price, so comparing markets or dates carries exchange-rate drift. Absent only when exchange rates were unavailable — the response's warnings then say why.

currency.description: The market's own currency: USD for TCGplayer, EUR for Cardmarket.

market.description: The marketplace this price is from.

amount.description: No price. 'reason' says why, and absence is never a price of zero.

market.description: The marketplace this price would be from.

reason.description: Why there is no price. 'no_listing': the market lists no product for this card at all. 'variant_unpriced': it lists the card but has no price for this printing, or none for this basis. 'variant_not_printed': the catalogue records that the card was never printed this way, so no market will price it — check the variant named. 'separate_product': the printing is sold as a marketplace product of its own whose price is not carried, such as Base Set's 1st Edition or a Poké Ball reverse. 'window_unavailable': the basis is a day average and only Cardmarket publishes those. 'platform_unpriced': a Pokémon TCG Pocket card, which is digital and never sold. 'unavailable': the card could not be read from the catalogue at all — not the same as unpriced. 'unrecognised_shape': upstream sent price data in a shape this server does not understand.

cardmarket.description: Cardmarket's price, whose 'market' basis is its trend price.

printing.description: Upstream's own description of a printing sold under a marketplace product of its own, in the requested language. Present only on such an entry, whose prices are both null with reason `separate_product`: no variant name covers it, so it cannot be priced by naming it.

ageHours.description: How many hours old asOf is when this response was built, to one decimal place. Null when asOf is.

amount.description: The price in the market's own currency, for one copy in unspecified condition. A marketplace figure, not what a seller would receive after fees.

approximateVariant.description: True when the price may not be for exactly the printing named. asOfApproximate.description: True when this market sent no timestamp of its own and asOf is the other market's, from the same upstream import.

convertedAmount.description: The price in the requested currency, rounded half-to-even to two decimals, at the rate the response's exchangeRates gives for this market's currency — the same as amount when the two currencies match. Converted at the latest reference rate, not the rate of the day the market recorded the price, so comparing markets or dates carries exchange-rate drift. Absent only when exchange rates were unavailable — the response's warnings then say why.

market.description: The marketplace this price is from.

amount.description: No price. 'reason' says why, and absence is never a price of zero.

market.description: The marketplace this price would be from.

tcgplayer.description: TCGplayer's price, whose 'market' basis is its market price.

variant.description: The printing these prices are for. Absent only on an entry for a printing sold as a product of its own, which `printing` describes instead.

warnings.description: Anything that limits how far this entry's prices can be relied on — chiefly the two markets pricing the same printing more than 10× apart, which usually means one market's figure belongs to a different product, so neither should be trusted without checking. Absent when nothing does.

totals.description: One total per market, never blended into one: the two markets measure prices differently, and a line priced in one market may be unpriced in the other.

anyOf.description: An amount in the requested currency.

amount.description: The same sum in the requested currency: converted once, at the rate the response's exchangeRates gives for this market's currency, and rounded once, half-to-even, from the exact native sum — never the sum of the rounded per-line conversions, which can differ from it by under half a cent per line. Null only when exchange rates were unavailable.

complete.description: True only when every line was priced in this market, so the total covers the whole list. False when any line was unpriced, ambiguous or unavailable here — 'lines' says how many of each — because an unpriced printing may still be worth something the data does not carry.

lines.description: How every line fared in this market. They always add up to the number of lines asked for.

ambiguous.description: How many named no variant on a card whose price could not be pinned to the copy held, and so were left out.

priced.description: How many contributed a price from this market.

unavailable.description: How many could not be read from the catalogue at all. Not the same as unpriced: these may well have a price.

unpriced.description: How many were read successfully but have no price in this market.

nativeAmount.description: The sum of every priced line in this market's own currency, unit price × quantity, exact.
